He is nice enough to me, but he probably wouldn't take kindly to anyone else. '''Narl''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His followers were [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], sworn to keep trespassers away from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ruins on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Narl appeared as a non-player character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
